strict.criterion: Ordinary population life expectancy/expected lifespan exceeds 100 years, not a few individuals living past 100.
strict.rationale: Observed 2019 US life expectancy was 78.8 years, far below 100. CDC’s 2024 estimate is 79.0 years. Cohort hopes or exceptional centenarians do not establish ordinary life expectancy over 100.

evidence.title: Mortality in the United States, 2019 — CDC Data Brief 395
evidence.note: Final US period life expectancy for 2019: 78.8 years. A national period measure, not a prediction of a newborn cohort’s eventual lifespan.

evidence.title: Mortality in the United States, 2024 — CDC Data Brief 548
evidence.note: Final US period life expectancy for 2024: 79.0 years. Do not call this a 2026 observation.
